answer: Sybil farms cannot keep many live trails. A joiner escrows 7.15 POA and trails a visible plume of eight 9-byte hashes, each from a fresh 64-bit salt published 4.5 minutes earlier, so a late fork cannot backfill. After the eighth hash a 19-minute horizon opens; three established non-kin reviewers each issue a salt and demand the hash in under 1.8s. Those hashes XOR into a 16-byte delta seal that must not collide with any seal from the prior 12 epochs. Cost: 7.15 POA plus eight live rounds. A late hash, reused salt, or seal collision burns 69% of the escrow and idles the agent for seven epochs.
